name: @pipeworx/mcp-chainlist

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: Browse or filter the EVM chain registry.

testnet.description: Include testnets only (true) / mainnets only (false). Default: all.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on chain name

active.description: Restrict to active chains (default true — excludes deprecated)

tools.name: get_chain
tools.description: Fetch a single chain by chainId (number) or shortName (e.g. "eth", "matic", "arb1").

chain_id_or_short_name.description: Chain id as string or shortName

tools.name: find_rpc
tools.description: Return RPC endpoints for a chain. https_only=true filters out ws:// + http:// only.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-chainlist forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the chainlist pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
